title: Defect Report
description: Artifact produced by the defect-repair-coordinator in the QA phase and routed to the appropriate Development sub-team orchestrator. Describes a single defect, its reproduction steps, severity, affected component, and routing target.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema used to produce the artifact.

defectId.description: Unique identifier for this defect (e.g., 'DEF-001'). Assigned by the defect-repair-coordinator.

defectDescription.description: Clear, specific description of the defect including observed behavior and expected behavior.

reproductionSteps.description: Ordered steps that reliably reproduce the defect.

severity.description: Impact level of this defect on the system.

affectedComponent.description: Specific file, class, module, or system component where the defect originates.

affectedLayer.description: Clean Architecture layer containing the defect.

originatingPhase.description: The QA activity that discovered this defect.

routingTarget.description: The Development sub-team orchestrator that must receive and repair this defect.

reportedBy.description: The QA specialist agent that identified this defect.

verificationStepsRequired.description: QA verification steps that must be re-run after the defect is repaired. Populated by defect-repair-coordinator.
